_comment: Generated by the Release workflow on every merge to main. This file IS the listing Dalamud installs from, and dist/latest.zip is the build it fetches - both served as plain files so installing is a single request.
Author: monkdim
Name: One Two Punch
Description: Collapses each supported DPS job into a single-target button and an AoE button. The button shows the action that is correct right now given your cooldowns, gauge, buffs, target count and whether you are moving. It never presses anything for you: one keypress is always exactly one action.
Punchline: Two buttons. Your whole DPS rotation. You still throw the punches.
